chapter: Kenton, Granz, Parker and the jazz clubs
title: First meeting Charlie Parker on 52nd Street
summary: He heard Parker, Gillespie and Max Roach on 52nd Street and couldn't sleep.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Okay, I want to get back to Charlie Parker playing and recording with you. Do you remember the first time you met Parker?

Well, the first day -- the first time, I really don't know exactly where that I met Parker. I know that (inaudible), the first time I met Parker was on 52nd Street. What was the name of that club there? I was playing at this, and I went to listen to the -- there was Brown on the bass. They had a white piano player. There was Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie and the drummer with this -- what was the name of this guy?
Max Roach. That's the man's name. I got him here, and I got his (inaudible), but I couldn't get -- I couldn't sleep that night. I mean, they play so much stuff --
-- that I couldn't sleep that night. That was a hell of a loop. They play like this, like a machine.

That's what I say, then when I (inaudible), when I saw about this -- after while I saw with a big band, I was disappointed, because I got -- I know the (inaudible), you know, and he didn't have that (inaudible) musician (inaudible).
